name: FX Amount Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of amount for foreign exchange commissions or fees.

WITH.name: Withholding Tax
WITH.definition: Tax is on income deducted at source, which the paying agent is legally obliged to deduct from its payments of interest on deposits and other proceeds of a financial instrument.

VATA.name: Value Added Tax
VATA.definition: Tax is a value added tax.

STEX.name: Stock Exchange Tax
STEX.definition: Tax collected by a stock exchange.

STAM.name: Stamp Duty
STAM.definition: Tax is on certain documents and transactions.

OTHR.name: Other Amount
OTHR.definition: Another type of commission or fees.

COUN.name: National Federal Tax
COUN.definition: Tax is a country, national, or federal tax that is usually charged by the custodian.

LOCL.name: Local Tax
LOCL.definition: Tax that is charged by a local settlement system or local jurisdiction.

LYDT.name: German Local Tax 4
LYDT.definition: Local tax (Ertrag Besitzanteilig) yield liable for interest down payment tax.

LOTE.name: German Local Tax 3
LOTE.definition: Local tax (Zinstopf) offset interest per unit against tax exempt amount (variation to offset interest per unit in relation to tax exempt amount).

LIDT.name: German Local Tax 2
LIDT.definition: Local tax (ZAS pflichtige Zinsen) - interest liable for interest down payment tax (proportion of gross interest per unit/interim profits that is not covered by the credit in the interest pool).

EUTR.name: EU Tax Retention
EUTR.definition: Tax withheld at source in the framework of the European Directive on taxation of savings in the form of interest payments.

EQUL.name: Equalisation
EQUL.definition: Investor's subscription amount that is held by the fund in order to pay incentive / performance fees at the end of the fiscal year.

COAX.name: Consumption Tax
COAX.definition: Tax that is levied on goods and services purchased by customers, and is added to the retail price.

AKTI.name: Aktiengewinn
AKTI.definition: Share-related profit. This is a tax specific to the German market. The share-related-profit gives the fund the opportunity to pass on to the institutional investor redeeming fund units certain tax-free income from equity. The calculation method is based on the old Investment Tax Act (Investmentsteuergesetz).

MARG.name: Margin Amount
MARG.definition: Margin amount related commissions and fees.

MACO.name: Matching Or Confirmation Fees
MACO.definition: Fee charged for matching and/or confirmation.

ANTO.name: Net Gain Loss
ANTO.definition: Amount representing the difference between the cost and the current price of a security. In the context of securities settlement, it is the amount paid or received when the instructions are netted or paired off.

CREB.name: Rebate Bonification
CREB.definition: Rebate or bonification fees or commission amount.

SPCN.name: Special Concessions
SPCN.definition: Fees, drawdown, or other reduction from or in addition to the deal price.

TOTL.name: Total
TOTL.definition: Total amount of all commissions or fees

ACRU.name: Accrued Interest
ACRU.definition: Amount of interest earned on a debt, such as a bond, but not yet collected.

BAKL.name: Back Load Fee
BAKL.definition: Amount paid by investors when selling mutual fund shares.

CHAR.name: Charges And Fees
CHAR.definition: Amount of money that cannot be categorised by another qualifier.

CBCH.name: Correspondent Bank Charge
CBCH.definition: Charge of the correspondent bank for transferring money.

LADT.name: German Local Tax 1
LADT.definition: Local tax (ZAS Anrechnungsbetrag) subject to interest down payment tax (proportion of interest liable for interest down payment tax/interim profit that is not covered by the tax exempt amount).

HDGE.name: Hedging Cost
HDGE.definition: Amount due and payable to a hedge counterparty under a hedge agreement during the relevant period.

ISDI.name: Issue Discount Allowance
ISDI.definition: Amount of money defined as a discount on a new issue or on a tranche of an existing issue.

OCMT.name: Original Currency Amount
OCMT.definition: Posting/settlement amount in its original currency when conversion from/into another currency has occurred.

PRMA.name: Premium Amount
PRMA.definition: Difference between the amount of money of the first leg and the amount of the second leg of the transaction.

OTMG.name: On Top Margin
OTMG.definition: Amount is an on top margin.

REGF.name: Regulatory Fees
REGF.definition: Amount of money charged by a regulatory authority, for example, Securities and Exchange fees.

REMU.name: Remuneration Amount
REMU.definition: Amount of any other remuneration received or to be received by the broker in connection with the transaction.

RESU.name: Resulting Amount
RESU.definition: Counter value of a foreign exchange conversion.

SAMG.name: Sales Margin
SAMG.definition: Financial metric used to assess a firm's financial health by revealing the proportion of money left over from revenues after accounting for the cost of goods sold. Gross profit margin serves as the source for paying additional expenses and future savings.

SHIP.name: Shipping Charge
SHIP.definition: Charge for shipping, including the insurance of securities.

ACCA.name: Accrued Capitalisation
ACCA.definition: Amount of unpaid interest (on bonds which have defaulted and have subsequently |restructured), which is capitalized and added to the original principal amount of the bond.

PRDF.name: Difference In Price
PRDF.definition: Difference between the deal price and another reference price.

PRWI.name: Partial Redemption Withholding Amount
PRWI.definition: Amount retained by a fund and paid out later at a time decided by the fund.

RSCH.name: Research Fee
RSCH.definition: Charge or commission paid by the investor to a distributor/intermediary or other service provider for the provision of financial research.
